patch.summary: InboxAlly implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement InboxAlly by mapping current email-marketing workflows to InboxAlly objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (HubSpot, Klaviyo) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on HubSpot

blocks.heading: InboxAlly day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat InboxAlly setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for automation workflows before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Senders with damaged domain reputation before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate HubSpot and Klaviyo before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP
Do not expand seats until automation workflows is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Pricing scales steeply with sender profiles and seed volume

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Requires including seed addresses in sends

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Reputation repair often takes weeks — trial alone may not prove full repair

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: InboxAlly plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Starter
lines.description: 10-day trial · Unlocks: automation workflows, analytics, deliverability tools · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Plus
lines.description: 10-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Premium
lines.description: 10-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate email-marketing fit before a deep InboxAlly rollout
blocks.body: If InboxAlly fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft InboxAlly object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on automation workflows
If blocked, evaluate Bouncer before sunk-cost expansion
